question: The sum of the length and breadth of a cuboid is 16 cm. If the height of the cuboid is 1/4 of the sum of its length and breadth, then what is the lateral surface area of the cuboid?
solution:
Given:

The sum of the length and breadth of a cuboid is 16 cm.

The height of the cuboid is 1/4 of the sum of its length and breadth.

Formula used:

The lateral surface area of a cuboid = 2 ×(l+b) × h

(l = length, b = breadth , h = height)

Calculation: 

Height of the cuboid will be

⇒ 1 / 4 × 16 = 4 cm

Lateral surface area will be,

⇒ 2 ×(l+b) × h = 2 ×16 × 4

⇒ 128 cm2

**∴ The correct option is 1**
